text: The Public Investment Fund's 2024 consolidated financial statements list The Red Sea Global Company among its subsidiaries, with a 100% ownership interest.
short: PIF owns 100% of Red Sea Global

source.name: Public Investment Fund: Consolidated Financial Statements for the year ended 31 December 2024 (archived copy of pif.gov.sa PDF), note 40 (list of subsidiaries)
source.quote: The Red Sea Global Company Real Estate 100.00%  100.00%

additionalSources.name: TradeArabia: Red Sea Global renews Al-Ahli sponsorship as AMAALA takes shirt front
additionalSources.quote: Red Sea Global (RSG), a PIF company and regenerative tourism developer, has renewed its sponsorship of Al-Ahli Saudi Football Club for the 2026-2027 season
